compatibility_reason: Latest upstream macOS13 Intel binary wheel; 49/50 fixes lack compatible wheels.
reachability_review: The app calls PyJWT RS256/ES256 signature verification with public JWKS. It does not call cryptography X.509 verification or PKCS7 decryption, the APIs affected by these advisories. HTTPS uses CPython ssl through httpx. This is a bounded reachability review, not a complete security audit.
